Messages.Body:
Couldn't find the answer. So...
Bestial Vengeance
Requires a Laibon. [ani] Only usable before range is determined.
Choose a retainer on this Laibon. This combat, this Laibon is immune
to frenzy cards and the opposing minion takes 1 damage during strike
resolution if the retainer is ready. A vampire can play only one
Bestial Vengeance each combat. [ANI] As above, but for 2 damage.

So for additional strikes... each has its own strike resolution. Does
the Bestial work on each one?

And I'm sure I missed it. It is not ranged damage correct?
